text: The difference between an eval and a unit test is that evals are for outputs that are never exactly the same twice, which is to say the non-deterministic outputs that you get from LLMs.

text: Traces record what your AI did at an incredible level of detail, so every agent step, every tool call, every LLM call, the inputs and outputs at every single step.

text: A trace is made up of what we call spans.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: Each span is one step in the execution.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: You can think of it as just a line in the log.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: And so a whole agent turns a span that has other spans nested inside of it.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: And each one records its input, its output, how long it took, how many tokens it used, and sometimes how much it cost.
speaker: SPEAKER_01

text: So traces tell you what happened and evals tell you whether it was any good.

text: And that is the whole mental model for today.
